notes.title: Stellar Mess: Operation Kush - latest update details!
notes.notes:
This update brings this changes:

- Default verbs depend on the object, for example, if you right-click on a door, it will open (you no longer have to choose “Open” before clicking on a door).

- Fixed a bug with music.

- I changed a few things story-wise to make the game fit better with the overall cohesion of the three chapters and some characters development.

[b]- 20 Steam Achievements added![/b]
